jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst
jobs.location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
jobs.description:
About Aidoc

Aidoc is the market leader in healthcare AI and has developed the world's largest clinical frontier model, supporting nearly 50 million patients each year.
Aidoc is deployed in more than 2,000 medical centers worldwide. Since our founding in 2016, Aidoc has raised over $500 million and achieved a record number of FDA-cleared solutions.

Medical diagnosis is hitting a breaking point, where the number of physicians hasn't kept up with the rapidly growing patient load. This leads to misdiagnosis and treatment delays that result in hundreds of thousands of deaths every year. Aidoc assists clinicians by precisely highlighting diseases directly on medical images, preventing misdiagnosis and ensuring that urgent patients receive the immediate attention they need.

About this role

We are looking for an experienced and insightful Senior Product Analyst with a specific focus on Platform Analytics to join our Product Analytics team. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping the user experience of our platform by analyzing and interpreting usage data, monitoring feature adoption, and supporting new feature launches with data-driven insights. This is an ideal position for someone with a passion for understanding user behavior and platform dynamics, alongside experience in tracking and optimizing key metrics that influence platform success and user satisfaction.

The Platform Analytics role requires a blend of analytical, technical, and collaborative skills, working alongside a cross-functional team of Product Managers, Customer Success Managers, Operations teams, Data Engineers, SW Developers, UI/UX Designers, and AI experts. Your insights will directly influence feature development and enhance the platform's usability, performance, and scalability.

Responsibilities

-
As a Senior Product Analyst specializing in Platform Analytics, you will be instrumental in advancing our platform's data-driven approach by focusing on:

- Analyzing platform usage patterns and deriving actionable insights to optimize user engagement and satisfaction

- Supporting the development of new features by monitoring early adoption, user interactions, and performance

- Partnering with Product Managers to establish and track key feature KPIs, assessing impact, and recommending enhancements

- Developing dashboards and reports that provide visibility into platform health, user behavior, and key usage trends for stakeholders

- Collaborating with Customer Success and Product teams to understand and address user pain points, drive improvements and reduce churn

- Continuously enhancing our analytics processes and data platforms to support agile and accurate insights for platform optimization

Requirements

-

- 5+ years of experience in Analytics, Product, or Platform domains, including roles such as Product Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as presentation skills

- B.Sc or equivalent studies with extensive hands-on projects

- A Master's degree - An advantage

Working at Aidoc

Our Perks:

- Be part of something big - using cutting-edge technologies to transform the Healthcare industry (while saving patients’ lives)

- We work in a hybrid model, with our new offices located at 34 HaMasger Street in Tel Aviv and parking for employees.

- Amazing and healthy breakfasts and lunches prepared daily by our personal chef!

- Stocked up kitchen & meal card

- Wellness: Aidoc employees-only gym, plus Pilates, Yoga, and functional workouts classes.

- Amazing culture - collaborative, transparent & fun!

- Attractive compensation package & benefits

Aidoc is deeply committed to creating an inclusive workplace, and to the principle of equal opportunity for all individuals. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

About this role

We are seeking an experienced sharp and dynamic analytical mind to join our Product Analytics team as a Strategic product analyst. This position is ideally suited for those who are naturally passionate about learning, gaining knowledge, and analyzing anything they do and see with experience in utilizing data to make a significant impact.

The role requires a combination of analytical, technical, problem-solving, communication, and project management skills, and it involves working closely with various stakeholders and customers - including Product Managers, Customer Success Managers, Operations teams, Data Engineers, UI/UX Designers, SW developers, and AI experts at all levels.

Responsibilities

As a Strategic product analyst at Aidoc’s Analytics group, you will play a critical role in expanding our data-driven vision and building analytics capabilities that create value for both our customers and internal teams. Your work will include:

- Building scalable customer-facing analytics and data-sharing products, transforming complex data and customer needs into reliable, intuitive, and standardized solutions.

- Partnering with Customer Success and Product teams to understand how customers use our products, identify opportunities to improve adoption and demonstrate value, and translate site needs into scalable analytical solutions.

- Leading strategic analyses across products, workflows, and clinical domains, connecting data from multiple parts of Aidoc’s ecosystem to uncover insights and support business and product decisions.

- Designing product KPIs and measurement frameworks, monitoring trends, and working with key stakeholders to translate findings into actionable insights.

- Conducting decision-support analyses for Product, Customer Success, development, and operational initiatives.

- Designing and improving scalable data models and analytics infrastructure that support customer-facing products, internal analytics, and repeatable analytical capabilities.

- Continuously expanding our analytics knowledge base, improving data quality and reliability, and documenting learnings to strengthen the team’s collective expertise.

The role is all about collaborating with stakeholders to craft their questions into tangible metrics and captivating visuals, empowering them to uncover insights and make informed decisions through the power of data. Plus, you get to dive deep into learning opportunities and document your discoveries, enriching our collective intelligence and fueling continuous improvement.

Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or a similar analytical role.

- Strong technical orientation and eagerness to understand data models, pipelines, and analytics infrastructure.

- Demonstrated ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and collaborate effectively across multiple functions and stakeholders.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as presentation skills

- B.Sc or equivalent studies with extensive hands-on projects
